# The generated I and ethics without a fundamental owner

**Lean integration, 6 October 2026:** [Ren requests completion without added assumptions or axioms](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-self-foundation-lean-no-additions.md). The [integrated model](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeModel.lean) now includes 43 additional audited theorems, all with empty axiom dependencies; the full check covers 14 modules and 162 declarations. This establishes structural representation criteria and precise limits on deriving orientation from coherence/invariance. **It does not yet establish self-formation or the complete ethical foundation.** [Results, independent review and remaining dependencies](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELF-FOUNDATION-LEAN-INTEGRATION.md) distinguish these scopes.

## Formal integration into the existing model

The [self module](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GeneratedSelf.lean) starts from the existing transition relation and derives which finite futures are compatible with a history. A proposed record preserves this information exactly iff it does not merge histories with different compatible futures. This criterion and its consistent history-update rule add no self/world labels or physical law. The interpreter constructed by the proof can be an analyst's mathematical object; the theorem does not install an acquired self-model inside the process.

A closed counterexample identifies the limit. In the existing toggle process, an empty history and a one-event history end in different states while every finite future word remains possible. No decoder depending only on the resulting continuation profiles can recover both endpoints. This rules out equating that profile with a demonstrated complete state representation. It does not require every useful self-model to track the phase or exclude richer, locally formed perspectives.

The [orientation module](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/EthicalOrientation.lean) separately derives a factual order by inclusion of feasible continuations. It also proves that ordering histories by length and ordering them in reverse both satisfy coherence and annotation-independence, yet rank the same actual histories oppositely. Therefore those conditions alone do not select a direction of value. History length is event count, not welfare; attached annotations are not generated selves. The result leaves richer experiential or practical grounds open.

The public entry point composes these interfaces on the same existing histories. A fresh source-only build and an independent reconstruction accept all 43 additions with empty axiom reports. Prior non-entry sources remain byte-identical; no ethical axiom, primitive event law or claimed universally benevolent dynamics is inserted. Earlier inherited standard axiom dependencies remain in their original theorems. [Verification and scope](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELF-FOUNDATION-LEAN-INTEGRATION.md) preserve those distinctions.

The positive formation bridge still needs an internally acquired, revisable representation that distinguishes the organization's own activity and changes its responses. Existing material-backed learning already makes acquired information affect commands, but supplies its memory/decoder recipes. Experience and the adversity-to-reason relation remain separate obligations. These formal results close specific representation and insufficiency claims, not the requested complete foundation.

## F15 History-conditioned representation and orientation limits

The [existing Lean entry point](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeModel.lean) now imports [GeneratedSelf](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GeneratedSelf.lean) and [EthicalOrientation](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/EthicalOrientation.lean). They retain the original `Process` and `Trace` and add no primitive dynamics or ethical premise.

For a declared process and initial state, let `Residual P s h w := Feasible P s (h ++ w)`. A record `r` admits an interpreter exact for all finite residual futures iff `r h = r k` implies agreement of those futures. The reverse direction constructs an interpreter by existentially pooling histories with the same record; no choice axiom is needed. The result concerns an exact information contract, not its physical acquisition, decidability, cost or universal necessity for selfhood.

The already-defined toggle law reaches different endpoints after zero and one event while retaining identical residual profiles. Consequently a profile-only decoder cannot recover both phases. The same law has zero-event and two-event histories with the same endpoints and profiles; event-count ordering and its converse are coherent and annotation-independent but rank them oppositely. Coherence and annotation-independence therefore do not select a growth direction. This does not identify event count with morality or prove that richer ethical grounding is impossible.

Continuation inclusion is independently a factual preorder with synchronous-composition and exact-projection preservation. A toggle cycle also excludes strict transitive improvement on every allowed state transition, without excluding an evaluative distinction between actions.

The [integration record](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELF-FOUNDATION-LEAN-INTEGRATION.md) and [independent review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELF-FOUNDATION-LEAN-REVIEW.md) accept 43 additions with empty axiom dependencies in a 14-module, 162-declaration build. F14 retains its separate C1/C2 contracts. Endogenous self formation, experiential realization and moral justification remain open; this section does not complete the assumption-free foundation.
